description: NaSnPHO₄F crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaSnPHO₄F sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(0), np.int64(1)) direction. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to five O and three equivalent F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.53-2.55 Å. There is one shorter (2.21 Å) and two longer (2.77 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Sn is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent O and one F atom. Both Sn-O bond lengths are 2.21 Å. The Sn-F bond length is 2.06 Å. P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.51-1.63 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sn, and one P atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂SnP trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to one P and one H atom. F is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to three equivalent Na and one Sn atom.
